projects.title: Defective Semiconductor Detection
projects.description: Collaborated with a team of 2 engineers to build a production-ready defect detection system. Built a high-precision defect detection system using YOLOv3 and RetinaNet, achieving 98% precision in identifying semiconductor defects. Engineered a computer vision pipeline combining OpenCV, Hough Transform, Canny edge detection, and ResNet for robust feature extraction. Deployed a containerized ML model to the factory floor with a 0.2-second inspection time per image.
